brief: Vernacular Italianate two-storey brick house (c.1845, remodelled c.1880): bracketed cornice, a canted bay window on the side, a small bracketed entrance porch and a long two-storey rear ell. Record gap: no photographs, only 5 measured drawing sheets (plans, all elevations, section, mouldings and brackets), which fix the proportions and details exactly.

facade.notes: HABS measured plans only: a side-hall plan -- the entrance and stair along one side, two rooms deep beside it, an octagonal bay on the side, a long service wing behind with later rooms and a back stair; two storeys

why.note: the side-hall plan: the town-lot house, narrow enough for a 30-40 ft lot
